lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the branchial region, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows along the lateral midline.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible traversing the mid-flank, creating a lattice where they intersect the horizontal lines of circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges display a sharp luminance gradient (high intensity on the dorsal side, shadow on the ventral side) running along the upper third of the flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Isolated, low-density high-luminance blobs are visible within the perimeter of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the base and leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, elongated remora is attached to the mid-lateral flank. An irregular high-luminance patch is visible on the dorsal surface posterior to the cranial region, possibly indicating a scar.
other_distinctive_markers: The primary pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, uniform high-luminance spots relative to the lateral flank pattern.
